T-241 is fixed and in review. During a live cohort, newcomers on the success, join and VIP pages now see the cohort on sale, and stamped attendees keep their own week.

decisions.decision: Keep the rule already in app/src/lib/cohort.ts: once Day 1 (Wed 11:00 ET) starts, the cohort on sale is the following Wed to Fri, and people who already signed up keep the week they joined. Fix /masterclass/success, /masterclass/success/join and the VIP pages so they show useCohort("sale") when the visitor has no stamp (no tantra-cohort in localStorage and no ?cohort= link) and useCohort("joined") when they do. Don't change cohort.ts or cloud/src/settings.ts. No date may be written into the copy, and dates must render on the client. Using the probes' clock override, set the clock to Wed 14 Oct 12:00 ET and to Fri 16 Oct 10:00 ET. In both, prove that a newcomer sees 21 to 23 Oct and a stamped attendee sees 14 to 16 Oct. Run probe-cohort and probe-workshop until both pass. Then commit, push, rebuild the public mirror and log it on T-241. Set it to review for Aquila and Adi.
decisions.why: weekly-cohort-schedule says newcomers see the new week and joined people keep theirs, and the rule in cohort.ts (5ab3f7b, 1db8ad1) already does that. Only the success, join and VIP pages are wrong. T-241's spec asks for clock-override testing because no real cohort is live (Pass 2 correction).

Both T-241 done-when items are met: log 2026-10-09T20:29 reports probe-cohort-live 36/36 plus probe-cohort and probe-workshop passing, pushed (2210e50, mirror 0ca03bcc8). I read app/src/lib/use-cohort.ts: unstamped "joined" falls back to saleCohortFor, matching weekly-cohort-schedule. Probes not re-run by me.
